title: Willow (Gilneas)
wikitext: {{Npcbox | name = Willow | image = Willow.png | level = 44 | faction = Combat | aggro = {{Aggro|-1|-1}} | race = Banshee | creature = Undead | gender = Female | location = [[Gilneas]] | status = Killable }} '''Willow''' is a banshee that appears during {{questlong|Alliance|44|The Black Waltz}}. One of the [[Widows of the Woods]], a fickle lot of spirits that hold a strong attachment to the woods of [[Gilneas]], Willow has begun to haunt young [[Aliattan Anderson]] out of spite due to him accidentally sparking a fire on her willow tree,[[Aliattan Anderson's Journal]] and sought to break his will and draw him into the "black waltz", a maddening dance that would see his soul itself be wrenched from his body with each twirl and spin, before being devoured by the hungry Widows.{{questlong|Alliance|44|The Black Waltz}} ==Quotes== :Another comes to bother these lands? I do not have the patience to toy with another.
